mapper.sql: AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${tableName} newer WHERE newer.device_id = r.device_id AND newer.delete_at IS NULL AND ( newer.create_at > r.create_at OR (newer.create_at = r.create_at AND newer.id > r.id) ) )
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.device_id, r.address, r.is_open AS opened, r.is_lock AS locked, r.lock_status, r.delay_time, r.create_at, r.update_at, r.delete_at FROM access_record r WHERE r.delete_at IS NULL AND r.device_id IN #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.device_id, r.address, r.self_id, r.is_open AS opened, r.mode, r.temperature, r.speed, r.room_temperature, r.error_code, r.create_at, r.update_at, r.delete_at FROM air_condition_record r WHERE r.delete_at IS NULL AND r.device_id IN #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.device_id, r.address, r.is_open AS opened, r.is_fix AS fixed, r.is_lock AS locked, r.voltage, r.current, r.power, r.energy, r.leakage, r.temperature, r.create_at, r.update_at, r.delete_at FROM circuit_break_record r WHERE r.delete_at IS NULL AND r.device_id IN #{id}
SELECT r.id, r.device_id, r.address, r.self_id, r.is_open AS opened, r.is_lock AS locked, r.create_at, r.update_at, r.delete_at FROM light_record r WHERE r.delete_at IS NULL AND r.device_id IN #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.device_id, r.address, r.self_id, r.temperature, r.humidity, r.light, r.smoke, r.create_at, r.update_at, r.delete_at FROM sensor_record r WHERE r.delete_at IS NULL AND r.device_id IN #{id}
